welcomeTitle.en: Let's get you ready for your visit.
welcomeTitle.translation: La oss gjøre deg klar for ditt besøk.

welcomeSubtitle.en: Answer a few questions about your symptoms. Your doctor reviews everything before you meet.
welcomeSubtitle.translation: Svar på noen spørsmål om symptomene dine.

identitySubtitle.en: This connects your visit to your record.
identitySubtitle.translation: Dette forbinder besøket ditt med registreringen din.

labelComplaint.translation: Hva bringer deg inn i dag?

interviewLoadError.translation: Vi kunne ikke laste inn intervjuet ditt.

interviewOpener.en: Thanks — I'll ask a few quick questions about your {complaint}. When did it start?
interviewOpener.translation: Takk, jeg vil stille deg et par spørsmål om {complaint}.

interviewOpenerFallback.en: Thanks — I'll ask a few quick questions about what brought you in. When did it start?
interviewOpenerFallback.translation: Takk, jeg vil stille deg et par spørsmål om hva som fikk deg inn.

composerHintChips.en: Type a reply, or tap a suggestion above
composerHintChips.translation: Skriv et svar, eller trykk på et forslag ovenfor

reviewSubtitle.en: Tap any item to fix it before sending.
reviewSubtitle.translation: Trykk på noe element for å fikse det før du sender.

btnSendToDoctor.translation: Ser riktig ut sende til legen

emergencyNotice.en: If your symptoms feel severe or are getting worse right now, don't wait — call emergency services.
emergencyNotice.translation: Hvis symptomene dine føles alvorlige eller blir verre akkurat nå, vent ikke ring nødhjelpen.

urgencyBody.en: Your symptoms suggest something that should be seen soon. We've flagged your case as urgent for the clinical team.
urgencyBody.translation: Symptomene dine antyder noe som bør ses snart.

urgencyStep1Desc.en: The clinical team receives your structured history immediately.
urgencyStep1Desc.translation: Det kliniske teamet mottar din strukturerte historie umiddelbart.

urgencyStep3Title.translation: Hvis det blir verre, handle raskt

urgencyStep3Desc.en: Severe or sudden worsening — call emergency services right away.
urgencyStep3Desc.translation: Svært eller plutselig forverring ring nødhjelpen umiddelbart.

notADiagnosis.en: This is an automated urgency estimate, not a diagnosis. A clinician makes the final decision.
notADiagnosis.translation: Dette er en automatisert vurdering, ikke en diagnose.

findHeroSubtitle.en: You've been seen at this hospital before. Send your brief straight there?
findHeroSubtitle.translation: Du har blitt sett på dette sykehuset før.

findHeroRecordsNote.en: They already hold your records, so your care team sees your full history right away.
findHeroRecordsNote.translation: De har jo dine poster, så omsorgsteamet ser hele historien din med en gang.

findSearchTitle.en: Where would you like to be seen?

findScanning.translation: Scanning Triavi sykehus i nærheten av deg...

findErrLocation.en: We couldn't get your location. Tap rescan to try again.

statusBody.en: Your brief is with the care team. We'll notify you the moment a clinician opens it.
statusBody.translation: Rapporten din er hos vårdgruppen, vi varsler deg så snart en kliniker åpner den.

escalateTitle.en: If it's getting worse, act now
escalateTitle.translation: Hvis det blir verre, handler du nå

escalateBody.en: Don't wait for your queue position. If your symptoms are severe or worsening suddenly — call emergency services now or go to the nearest emergency department.
escalateBody.translation: Hvis symptomene dine er alvorlige eller forverres plutselig, ring nødhjelpen nå eller gå til nærmeste nødhjelp.

escalateFlagged.en: We've flagged your case as higher priority so the care team is aware.
escalateFlagged.translation: Vi har merket saken din som høyere prioritet så omsorgsteamet er klar over det.

notifyBody.en: A clinician is reviewing your brief. We'll update you as it progresses.
notifyBody.translation: En kliniker ser over briefet ditt, vi vil oppdatere deg etter hvert som det utvikler seg.

checkinWelcomeSubtitle.en: Answer a few questions about how you've been since your visit.
checkinWelcomeSubtitle.translation: Svar på noen spørsmål om hvordan du har vært siden besøket ditt.

checkinTrendAriaLabel.en: How is your condition compared to before?
checkinTrendAriaLabel.translation: Hvordan er din tilstand sammenlignet med før?

checkinAnythingElse.en: Anything else you'd like to tell us?
checkinAnythingElse.translation: Er det noe annet du vil fortelle oss?

checkinResultResolved.translation: Vi er glade for at du føler deg bedre

checkinResultResolvedBody.en: We'll check in again {next} to make sure you're still improving.
checkinResultResolvedBody.translation: Vi sjekker igjen {next} for å være sikker på at du fortsatt forbedrer deg.

checkinResultReview.en: A clinician will look at this today
checkinResultReview.translation: En lege vil se på dette i dag.

checkinResultReviewBody.en: Your answers have been sent to the care team. A clinician will review them and reach out if needed.
checkinResultReviewBody.translation: Svarene dine er sendt til vårdgruppen.

checkinResultEscalate.translation: Vær så snill å søke omsorg nå

checkinResultEscalateBody.en: Your symptoms suggest something that needs prompt attention. Don't wait — contact your care team or go to the nearest emergency department.
checkinResultEscalateBody.translation: Symptomene dine antyder at det er noe som trenger umiddelbar oppmerksomhet.

checkinExpiredBody.en: This follow-up is no longer available. Sign in to see your current check-ins.
checkinExpiredBody.translation: Denne oppfølgingen er ikke lenger tilgjengelig. Logg inn for å se dine nåværende innmeldinger.

claimBody.en: Your check-in is verified. Create a free account to track this visit and skip the code next time.
claimBody.translation: Skap en gratis konto for å spore dette besøket og hoppe over koden neste gang.

authVerifyTitle.translation: La oss bekrefte det er deg

authVerifyBody.en: We'll send a one-time code — no password to remember.
authVerifyBody.translation: Vi sender en engangskode ingen passord å huske.

signinBody.en: Enter your phone or email and we'll send a sign-in code.
signinBody.translation: Skriv inn telefonen eller e-posten din og vi sender en innloggingskode.

signinAccountTied.en: Your account is tied to your hospital's records
signinAccountTied.translation: Kontoen din er knyttet til sykehusregistret.

errInvalidPhone.en: Enter a valid phone number (7–14 digits)
errInvalidPhone.translation: Skriv inn et gyldig telefonnummer (714 siffer)

errSendFailed.en: Couldn't send the code. Try again.
errSendFailed.translation: Jeg kunne ikke sende koden, prøv igjen.

errNetwork.en: Network error. Check your connection and try again.
errNetwork.translation: Nettverksfeil, sjekk tilkoblingen og prøv igjen.

errResendFailed.translation: Jeg kunne ikke sende tilbake, prøv igjen.

errCodeMismatch.en: That code didn't match. Try again.

sessionExpiredBody.en: For your security and to protect patient data, you've been signed out after a period of inactivity.
sessionExpiredBody.translation: For din sikkerhet og for å beskytte pasientdata, har du blitt signert ut etter en periode med inaktivitet.

dashNoActiveHint.en: Start a check-in to begin a new visit.
dashNoActiveHint.translation: Start en innsjekking for å starte et nytt besøk.

dashCareLinePrivacy.en: Care calls ring in this app · your phone number is never shared.
dashCareLinePrivacy.translation: Betjeningssamtaler ringer i denne appen · telefonnummeret ditt deles aldri.

voiceSubtitle.en: Choose who calls you, and how they sound.
voiceSubtitle.translation: Velg hvem som ringer deg, og hvordan de høres ut.

voiceSampleQuote.en: Hi Jordan, it's time for your evening dose…
voiceSampleQuote.translation: Hei Jordan, det er på tide med din kveldsdosis...

quietHoursDesc.en: No calls 9:30 PM – 7:30 AM · falls back to a notification
quietHoursDesc.translation: Ingen samtaler 9:30 pm 7:30 am · faller tilbake til en varsling

signedOutBody.en: Your care line stays active — sign back in to manage calls and reminders.
signedOutBody.translation: Vårdlinjen din forblir aktiv logg deg tilbake inn for å administrere samtaler og påminnelser.

callRingWebRtcFootnote.en: Encrypted voice call · WebRTC · your number is never shared
callRingWebRtcFootnote.translation: Kryptet telefonsamtale · WebRTC · ditt nummer blir aldri delt

visitsPrivacyNote.en: Only you and {hospital} can see these. Tap a visit to read the summary shared with you.
visitsPrivacyNote.translation: Bare du og {hospital} kan se disse.

visitDetailNoCalls.en: No care calls for this visit yet.
visitDetailNoCalls.translation: Ingen omsorg krever dette besøket ennå.

visitDetailNotDiagnosis.en: This is a summary shared with you — not a diagnosis. If your symptoms return or get worse, seek emergency care right away.
visitDetailNotDiagnosis.translation: Dette er en oppsummering delt med deg ikke en diagnose. Hvis symptomene tilbake eller blir verre, søk nødhjelp umiddelbart.

visitDetailNotFoundBody.en: This visit may have been removed, or the link is no longer valid. Go back to see your full history.
visitDetailNotFoundBody.translation: Dette besøket kan ha blitt fjernet, eller lenken er ikke lenger gyldig.

editProfileSubtitle.en: Update your details. Your doctor sees the latest.
editProfileSubtitle.translation: Oppdater detaljene dine, legen din ser det siste.

profilePreferredLanguageDesc.en: Changes the language of every screen instantly.
profilePreferredLanguageDesc.translation: Endrer språket på hver skjerm umiddelbart.

profileCareLineCopyFailed.en: Couldn't copy - select and copy manually
profileCareLineCopyFailed.translation: Kan ikke kopiere - velg og kopiere manuelt

privacySubtitle.en: What we protect, and what you control.
privacySubtitle.translation: Hva vi beskytter, og hva du kontrollerer.

privacyDeidBody.en: Your name, contact details, and free-text answers are stripped before anything leaves your hospital. Only your care team sees identifying details; research and analytics see de-identified data only.
privacyDeidBody.translation: Navnet, kontaktopplysningene og svarene fra gratis tekst blir fjernet før noe forlater sykehuset.

privacyResearchConsentDesc.en: Allow de-identified data to improve care for everyone. You can change this anytime.
privacyResearchConsentDesc.translation: Du kan endre dette når som helst.

privacyCommsConsentDesc.en: Appointment reminders and follow-up check-ins by call or push. You can change this anytime.
privacyCommsConsentDesc.translation: Du kan endre dette når som helst.

privacyDeleteDesc.en: Permanently remove your account and contact details. Your care-line history is retained by your hospital as required by law.
privacyDeleteDesc.translation: Din konto og kontaktopplysninger er permanent fjernet.

privacyDownloadDesc.en: Request a copy of your visit summaries, medications, and care-call history.
privacyDownloadDesc.translation: Be om en kopi av oppsummeringen av besøket, medisiner og omsorgshistorie.

deleteSheetBody.en: This permanently removes your account and contact details. Your hospital retains your care-line history as required by law. This cannot be undone.
deleteSheetBody.translation: Dette fjerner kontoen og kontaktopplysningene dine permanent.

deleteRequestNextStep.en: Your care team will confirm by email within 72 hours. Your care line stays active until then.
deleteRequestNextStep.translation: Vårdgruppen din vil bekrefte via e-post innen 72 timer.

downloadSheetBody.en: Choose a format and request your export. We'll prepare it and send a secure link to your registered email.
downloadSheetBody.translation: Velg et format og be om eksport. Vi vil forberede det og sende en sikker lenke til din registrerte e-post.

downloadRequestNextStep.en: We'll email a secure link to your registered address within 24 hours.
downloadRequestNextStep.translation: Vi sender en sikker lenke til din registrerte adresse innen 24 timer.

downloadFileStubNote.en: No file is downloaded here - your records are sent securely to your registered email.
downloadFileStubNote.translation: Ingen fil er lastet ned her - dine poster sendes sikkert til din registrerte e-post.

callSummaryDeclinedLogged.en: Call declined ? logged as no contact
callSummaryDeclinedLogged.translation: Ring avslått logget som ingen kontakt

callSummaryEndedLogged.en: Call ended ? logged as no contact
callSummaryEndedLogged.translation: Kall avsluttet logget som ingen kontakt

inviteBody.en: Paste the invite link your hospital sent, or scan their QR code.
inviteBody.translation: Legg inn invitasjonslenken sykehuset sendte, eller skanne QR-koden.

inviteError.en: That doesn't look like a Triavi invite link or code.
inviteError.translation: Det ser ikke ut som en Triavi invitasjon link eller kode.

inviteScanSubtitle.en: Point your camera at the code

inviteInfoStreaming.en: A valid clinic code takes you straight to your details.
inviteInfoStreaming.translation: En gyldig klinikkode tar deg rett til dine detaljer.

inviteInfoDev.en: A valid clinic code takes you straight to your details. Dev: tap Simulate detected code to test the flow.
inviteInfoDev.translation: En gyldig klinikkode tar deg rett til detaljene dine.

inviteInfoDenied.en: Grant camera permission in your browser settings, or enter the invite link manually.
inviteInfoDenied.translation: Gi kameratillatelse i nettleserinnstillingene dine, eller skriv inn invitasjonslenken manuelt.

inviteInfoNoDevice.en: No camera detected. Enter the invite link your hospital sent instead.
inviteInfoNoDevice.translation: Ingen kamera oppdaget. skriv inn inn invitasjonslenken sykehuset sendte i stedet.

inviteInfoUnavailable.en: Camera isn't available right now. Enter the invite link manually.

interviewOfflineTitle.en: Offline ? showing the saved interview script
